domain: fixed z>0; meromorphic epsilon continuation from 1/2<Re(eps)<1
normalization: prepared fixed CA^2*CF channel; sym=4; exactly one Euler factor

full_epsilon.numerical_limitations: independent low-dimensional quadrature; no rigorous numerical interval or infinite-tail bound
